_meta.what: Watermarks and cadences for the recurring routines. This tiny file is what lets the system run rituals with NO cron and NO scheduler: the session-start read checks the dates here and nudges when something is due. A cloud cron would only ever see last-pushed state, so it would demand constant pushing, which is upkeep.

weekly_review.note: When today - last_review >= cadence_days, surface a one-line nudge in whatever chat is open. Stamp today's date here after a review runs. null means it has never run.

capture_ingestion.note: Optional. Point 'source' at a file or doc you brain-dump into. The watermark stops the same notes being ingested twice.
